actual_file = "/private/var/folders/vm/xpzxhfhn76x_ns21zfd5dyk80000gn/T/sal_clawbench_data-016_iffnd5n3/actual_extracted.csv"

    budget = OrderedDict((row[0], float(row[1])) for row in reader)

summary = []

    act_amt = actual.get(cat, 0.0)

    status = "on-budget" if round(act_amt,2)==round(bud_amt,2) else ("over-budget" if act_amt > bud_amt else "under-budget")
    rec = {"category": cat, "budget": round(bud_amt,2), "actual": round(act_amt,2), "difference": diff, "status": status}
    summary.append(rec)
    total_budget += bud_amt
    total_actual += act_amt
    if status=="over-budget":
        over_budget.append(cat)
    elif status=="under-budget":
        under_budget.append(cat)

    "over_budget_categories": sorted(over_budget),
    "under_budget_categories": sorted(under_budget)
}

with open(out_json, "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
